unit.why: An eyewitness anecdote, quoted from Eretz ha-Hayyim, about the rabbi of Zlotchov: he sensed that a chicken was treif although the question put to him showed nothing wrong, and it later proved treif on other grounds.

stories.start_quote: אגב אזכיר כאן דבר נפלא אחד
stories.summary_en: A boy brings intestines of a fowl to the rabbi of Zlotchov with a question. The rabbi argues to forbid it although the narrator finds no ground, and admits that his mouth will not say 'kosher'. The chicken is fetched and found to have a disqualifying wound. The rabbi then explains R. Nehunya ben ha-Kanah's prayer not to call the impure pure.
